title: SUPER: Smart User-Centric Popularity Exposure Reduction for Fair and Diverse Recommendations
authors: Yavru, I. B.; Yalcin, E.; Bilge, A.; Yilmaz Gunduz, S.
summary: Two-phase hybrid: (1) PRE-PROCESSING — Pareto partition of items by cumulative interaction volume (alpha=0.20); train two separate recommenders M_pop on head set and M_tail on tail set; (2) POST-PROCESSING — per user, compute Pop_u = |C_u ∩ H| / |C_u| (fraction of user's interactions that are head items). Set N_pop = floor(N*Pop_u), N_tail = N - N_pop. Build candidate pools C_pop=top-N_pop from M_pop, C_tail=top-N_tail from M_tail. BLUEPRINT-BASED MERGE: scan user's training history Lu (by position), pick next item from C_pop if blueprint[k]=head else from C_tail, falling back deterministically to the other pool when its quota is exhausted. Hard quota / soft blueprint.

metrics.APLT: Average Percentage of Long-Tail items (per user)
metrics.GKPI: General KPI = arithmetic mean of harmonic means of nDCG with each of {APLT, Entropy, Novelty, LTC}

relevance_extension: Our extension preserves the Pareto partition + blueprint merge core; wraps it with (a) Federated Learning for M_pop and M_tail (privacy), (b) Differential Privacy on FL gradients, (c) LLM-based user profiling for additional Pop_u estimation signal, (d) Multi-objective tuning of the head/tail split beyond pure historical ratio.
